newReleases.name: Sisyphus - The Walk Down
newReleases.desc:
The stone rolls down. You follow it. At the foot of the mountain, you begin again.

Sisyphus - The Walk Down is a small, illustrated narrative game about effort, repetition and the changing experience of the same task. Push, descend, and release to breathe as a spoken story unfolds across ten loops. The walk continues after the story’s arc.

• Written and performed by Christopher Blumzon.
• Recorded narration with accompanying subtitles.
• Simple touch controls, with an optional tap-to-start and tap-to-stop mode.
• Music, footsteps and the sound of the stone, with separate narration and music/FX settings.
• A saved walk on your device, ready to continue later.
• Play offline on iPhone and iPad, in landscape.

Always free. No in-app purchases.

Best with headphones.

Music: Unraveling and In This Moment by Scott Buckley, used under CC BY 4.0. Full credits are available inside the app.

Playtime: 20 minutes to infinity.
Around 20 minutes for the story. Continue the walk for as long as you like.

newReleases.name: NAGI: Hashi & Logic
newReleases.desc:
Find your flow. Connect every island.

NAGI turns Hashi into a quiet ritual of observation and deduction. Read the numbers, consider the possibilities and build a single network of bridges. There is no countdown: the challenge is in the puzzle.

600 generated puzzles, each individually verified to have exactly one solution. Six chapters progress from small boards to demanding networks. All levels are available from the start.

Play offline, with automatic local saves, undo and redo, board zoom, day and night themes, optional sounds and haptics. A playable tutorial teaches the rules. Earn a completion mark without hints, or reveal a bridge when you want help.

The daily challenge selects a puzzle from the included collection and tracks your streak. No account is required. Progress stays on your device.

A few rules. Endless possibilities.
• Each number is the total number of bridges that must touch that island.
• Tap two aligned neighbouring islands. Repeat for a double bridge; repeat again to remove it.
• Bridges run horizontally or vertically. They cannot cross or pass through an island.
• Connect every island into one network. Matching the numbers alone is not enough.

Remove banners and interstitials. Unlimited hints. One purchase, all 600 levels already included.

The free version contains banner and occasional interstitial ads. Rewarded videos are optional and grant 3 hints only when completed. Ads, rewards and purchases require internet and availability. Premium is a on

newReleases.name: Pianova
newReleases.desc:
Exercise your memory while playing with music.
PIANOVA is a musical memory game where you listen to, remember and repeat sequences of notes. Start with simple sequences and progress through increasingly challenging levels while putting your memory and concentration to the test.
How do you play?
Listen carefully to the sequence played on the piano. Then it’s your turn: repeat the notes in the same order.
Each level adds a new challenge. How far can you go?
100 levels to master
Progress from the first simple sequences to increasingly difficult levels. Every game is a new opportunity to improve your memory and beat your own record.
A game to exercise your memory
PIANOVA combines music and memory in a simple and entertaining experience. Listening to and remembering the sequences challenges you to stay focused and remember the order of the notes.
Different ways to play
• Easy — More time to memorize the sequences.
• Normal — The classic PIANOVA experience.
• Hard — Faster sequences for those looking for a greater challenge.
• Free Play — Play all 12 piano keys with no lives or turns.
• Daily Challenge — A new challenge every day to try to beat your best result.
Play at your own pace
You have lives to help you progress through the levels, and you can get more when you need them. You can also unlock the Premium experience to play without ads and enjoy unlimited lives.
Listen. Remember. Play.
Can you remember the entire sequence?

Casa Brisca brings Puerto Rico’s card game to a table that feels real: 40-card Spanish deck, La Vida on the felt, and the rules you’ve always known. Play online, with your friends, or against Doña Tere when you have no signal.
GAME MODES

• El Rápido (1 vs 1): short online matches against real players.

• La Pareja (2 vs 2): team up and win tricks with your partner.

• La Sala (private): create a table and invite your friends with a code.

• Doña Tere (offline): play against the bot whenever you want, no internet.

• La Escuela: eight two-minute lessons to learn from scratch.
A TABLE THAT FEELS REAL

• La Vida always in sight: you never lose the trump suit.

• Expanding tricks: tap your tricks to review what you’ve won.

• Fast chat and emotes: table phrases to joke around without typing.

• Clear turn alerts: you always know when it’s your turn.
CLIMB THE RANKS

Every trick counts. Start in Café League, rise to Silver and Gold. Add your friends and compare your progress.
YOUR DECK, YOUR TABLE

newReleases.name: Meow Pup:Pair Puzzle Doku
newReleases.desc:
A little logic. A lot of cute.

Meet a cheerful cat and a playful pup in a cozy grid puzzle. Every empty square is a small decision: cat or dog? Look for clues, find the balance, and bring the whole board together.

TWO SIMPLE RULES
• Keep an equal number of cats and dogs in every row and column.
• Never place three of the same pet in a row, horizontally or vertically.

Start with the pets already on the board and work out where the others belong. Simple rules give every choice a purpose.

TAP, THINK, SOLVE
Tap an empty square to choose a cat or a dog. Read the board, spot a pattern, and make your next move.

A LITTLE HELP WHEN YOU NEED IT
Use a hint when you feel stuck, undo a move to rethink your choice, or restart for a fresh look at the puzzle.

MAKE EVERY MOVE COUNT
Finish a level and see your time, moves, and best streak. Enjoy a satisfying solve, then meet your next challenge.

YOUR COZY PUZZLE BREAK
Soft colors, expressive pets, and a clean board make room for a little focused fun whenever you want a break.

Find a place for every pet. Find your moment of balance.

newReleases.name: SOC Watch
newReleases.desc:
SOC Watch turns cybersecurity incident response into an idle strategy game.

You're running a Security Operations Center under constant attack. Incident waves spawn continuously and travel toward your core — your job is to keep three defense layers upgraded and firing fast enough to neutralize them before they breach your absorption capacity:

• EDR — your first line of detection and response
• SIEM — correlates and escalates what EDR can't catch alone
• Threat Intel — the deepest layer, holding the line when everything else is overwhelmed

Each layer has its own Cadence (fire rate), Neutralize (success chance), and Budget/Kill (reward) upgrades — spend your budget wisely as incident waves grow larger and Major Incidents test your defenses every ten waves.

If your absorption capacity runs out, it's a full breach: a post-mortem kicks in with a permanent bonus for your next run, and you start over stronger than before. Progress keeps ticking while you're away too — come back to a "welcome back" bonus, with the option to watch a single optional ad to double it.

No account, no pressure, no pay-to-win — just watch the wave counter climb and see how long your SOC can hold.

newReleases.desc:
KinetiJoy turns comfortable movement into a controller for active, family-friendly games. Choose a story or challenge, select head, hand, arm, or full-body controls, follow a short positioning guide, and start playing.

PLAY YOUR WAY

• Explore 26 original games and story adventures
• Choose flexible movement controls for seated or standing play
• Use supported touch controls whenever you prefer
• Follow friendly first-time guidance and position checks
• Keep profiles, progress, rewards, and preferences on your device

PRIVACY BY DESIGN

KinetiJoy uses the front camera only while motion controls are active. Camera frames and temporary movement landmarks are processed on the device for gameplay. They are not recorded or uploaded to AzharLabs. Players can stop the camera at any time.

BUILT FOR FAMILIES

Core play does not require a child account, advertising profile, contacts, or precise location. Parent-facing controls keep privacy choices and future purchases away from the main play flow.

Movement recognition can vary with lighting, camera position, device performance, and the player’s distance from the screen. Always play in a safe, clear space and choose movements that feel comfortable.

 • Great for quick breaks and brain training

SMASH EVERY CASTLE. RULE EVERY ARENA.

Build your defenses, choose your crew, and smash your opponent's hard work to pieces in Castle Busters, a turn-based online PvP battle game.

updates.name: Food Hunt: Pixel Puzzle
updates.desc:
Every level is a pixel art masterpiece. Your ants will devour it - one color at a time.

Food Hunt is a satisfying color sort puzzle where the puzzle board IS the art. Each level presents a hand-crafted pixel art image built entirely from colored blocks. Sort your ants by color, send them in, and watch them eat the picture clean - block by block, until the board is empty and the level is cleared.

HOW TO PLAY
The board is filled with a pixel art image - built entirely from colored blocks. Below the board: your holding slots and block stacks waiting to be tapped.

Tap a block stack to load your ants. They march up and devour every matching colored block in the image. Clear all colors - wipe the board completely - and you win.

But choose your order carefully:

- Holding slots are limited - wrong tap order fills them fast
- Stuck slots = ants can't move = game over
- Plan which color to clear first
- Eat every last block - board empty - level clear!

THE PIXEL ART IS THE PUZZLE
Forget collecting rewards after you win. In Food Hunt, the pixel art image is the challenge itself.

Every level is a different image, built from hundreds of colored blocks. Watch your ants devour it layer by layer, color by color, until nothing remains.

You don't unlock the art. You clear it. And that's exactly what makes it satisfying.

FEATURES
-  200+ color sort puzzle levels -  new images, new challenges
-  Cute ants with ASMR-quality chomping animations
-  Simple one-tap controls - play with one h

all.name: NAGI: Hashi & Logic
all.desc:
Find your flow. Connect every island.

NAGI turns Hashi into a quiet ritual of observation and deduction. Read the numbers, consider the possibilities and build a single network of bridges. There is no countdown: the challenge is in the puzzle.

600 generated puzzles, each individually verified to have exactly one solution. Six chapters progress from small boards to demanding networks. All levels are available from the start.

Play offline, with automatic local saves, undo and redo, board zoom, day and night themes, optional sounds and haptics. A playable tutorial teaches the rules. Earn a completion mark without hints, or reveal a bridge when you want help.

The daily challenge selects a puzzle from the included collection and tracks your streak. No account is required. Progress stays on your device.

A few rules. Endless possibilities.
• Each number is the total number of bridges that must touch that island.
• Tap two aligned neighbouring islands. Repeat for a double bridge; repeat again to remove it.
• Bridges run horizontally or vertically. They cannot cross or pass through an island.
• Connect every island into one network. Matching the numbers alone is not enough.

Remove banners and interstitials. Unlimited hints. One purchase, all 600 levels already included.

all.name: SOC Watch
all.desc:
SOC Watch turns cybersecurity incident response into an idle strategy game.

You're running a Security Operations Center under constant attack. Incident waves spawn continuously and travel toward your core — your job is to keep three defense layers upgraded and firing fast enough to neutralize them before they breach your absorption capacity:

• EDR — your first line of detection and response
• SIEM — correlates and escalates what EDR can't catch alone
• Threat Intel — the deepest layer, holding the line when everything else is overwhelmed

Each layer has its own Cadence (fire rate), Neutralize (success chance), and Budget/Kill (reward) upgrades — spend your budget wisely as incident waves grow larger and Major Incidents test your defenses every ten waves.

If your absorption capacity runs out, it's a full breach: a post-mortem kicks in with a permanent bonus for your next run, and you start over stronger than before. Progress keeps ticking while you're away too — come back to a "welcome back" bonus, with the option to watch a single optional ad to double it.

No account, no pressure, no pay-to-win — just watch the wave counter climb and see how long your SOC can hold.

It’s the perfect combination: a cube shooter that’s as soothing as it is intense, always very satisfying to clear the image at the end of a run.

But the park has tricks of its own. From the very first levels, you’ll see that this isn’t just mindless tapping. The game develops and gets more challenging and harder as you play, with clever layouts and sneaky blockers that force you to plan ahead. Each new level adds a fresh twist - more cubes, tougher patterns, and smarter obstacles that you’ll have to avoid if you want to keep your blast streak going.

To keep things interesting, you’ll unlock powerful level boosters that turn tight spots into epic comebacks.

all.desc:
Yarn Loop is a relaxing and satisfying puzzle game featuring colorful yarn bobbins and knitted patterns.

Bobbins move onto the conveyor and collect stitches of their own color. Each bobbin has a capacity value that decreases as stitches are picked up. When its capacity reaches zero, the bobbin disappears. If capacity remains, the bobbin is transferred to the rack and can be used again later.
 
Complete each knitted pattern by using the right bobbins in the right order.

Game Features
► Simple One-Tap Gameplay: Bobbins move smoothly through the conveyor system and collect matching stitches with ease.
► Color-Based Collection Mechanic: Each bobbin clears only the stitches of its own color.
► Capacity Management System: Every bobbin has a limited pickup value, creating thoughtful and satisfying puzzle decisions.
► Rack Reuse Function: Bobbins that still have capacity return to the rack and remain available for later use.
► Hundreds of Engaging Levels: New knitted layouts, color combinations, and puzzle arrangements appear throughout progression.
► Cozy Yarn Aesthetic: Soft textures, warm colors, and pleasant animations create a calm and enjoyable experience.

Yarn Loop offers a smooth, calm, and visually charming journey through handcrafted yarn puzzles.

all.desc:
Conveyor’s ready, pigs are on standby. Tap to send a pig onto the conveyor so it rains balls onto pixel cubes of its own color. The number above its head is its ammo: that’s how many hits it makes. Run out and it leaves the stage; if not, it slips into one of the 5 waiting slots and, when you tap again, it jumps back on the conveyor to fire another round.
The conveyor has a capacity—push past the limit and you’ll need to wait. Send them in the right order, manage the flow, and hit the cubes to clear the board piece by piece. Simple mechanic, sticky loop: tap → flow → repeat.
Highlights
One-tap control: Quick sessions, easy one-handed play.
Color matching: Pigs only hit their own color—no target-picking hassle.
Conveyor capacity: Timing and queue management add a bite-size strategy layer.
5 waiting slots: Stack, sort, and launch at the perfect moment.
Short but “one more round” feel: Perfect for micro-breaks.
Satisfying pixel cleanup: Every hit leaves the board feeling crisp.
For anyone who loves fast action-puzzles, timing, and flow management. The pigs are ready. The cubes… not so much.

all.name: Food Hunt: Pixel Puzzle
all.desc:
Every level is a pixel art masterpiece. Your ants will devour it - one color at a time.

Food Hunt is a satisfying color sort puzzle where the puzzle board IS the art. Each level presents a hand-crafted pixel art image built entirely from colored blocks. Sort your ants by color, send them in, and watch them eat the picture clean - block by block, until the board is empty and the level is cleared.

HOW TO PLAY
The board is filled with a pixel art image - built entirely from colored blocks. Below the board: your holding slots and block stacks waiting to be tapped.

Tap a block stack to load your ants. They march up and devour every matching colored block in the image. Clear all colors - wipe the board completely - and you win.

But choose your order carefully:

- Holding slots are limited - wrong tap order fills them fast
- Stuck slots = ants can't move = game over
- Plan which color to clear first
- Eat every last block - board empty - level clear!

THE PIXEL ART IS THE PUZZLE
Forget collecting rewards after you win. In Food Hunt, the pixel art image is the challenge itself.

Every level is a different image, built from hundreds of colored blocks. Watch your ants devour it layer by layer, color by color, until nothing remains.

You don't unlock the art. You clear it. And that's exactly what makes it satisfying.

FEATURES
-  200+ color sort puzzle levels -  new images, new challenges
-  Cute ants with ASMR-quality chomping animations
-  Simple one-tap controls - play with one h
